<?php
$src='/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/gg-seed/articles';
$dst='/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/gg-seed/articles';
if (is_dir($src)) {
  if (!is_dir($dst)) { mkdir($dst, 0777, true); }
  foreach (scandir($src) as $f) {
    if ($f==='.'||$f==='..') continue;
    if (is_file("$src/$f")) { @copy("$src/$f", "$dst/$f"); }
  }
  echo "ARTICLES_COPIED\n";
}
echo "plugins=".implode(",", array_values(array_diff(scandir('/wordpress/wp-content/plugins'), [".",".."])))."\n";
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
putenv('GG_ADMIN_PASS=N9F52WNZfSKNN607');
putenv('GG_LEARNER_PASS=RKxnA1pNHvD39bt5');
$_ENV['GG_ADMIN_PASS']='N9F52WNZfSKNN607';
$_ENV['GG_LEARNER_PASS']='RKxnA1pNHvD39bt5';
try {
  if (function_exists('gg_seed_run')) {
    delete_option('gg_seed_version');
    gg_seed_run();
    if (function_exists('gg_seed_refresh_home')) { gg_seed_refresh_home(); }
    update_option('gg_seed_version', defined('GG_SEED_VERSION') ? GG_SEED_VERSION : '1.2.0');
    $ids=get_option('gg_seed_ids');
    echo 'SEED_OK articles='.(isset($ids['articles'])?count((array)$ids['articles']):0)."\n";
  } else {
    echo "SEED_MISSING\n";
  }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  echo 'SEED_ERR='.$e->getMessage().' @ '.$e->getFile().':'.$e->getLine()."\n";
}
